title: Free Weights & Dumbbells Area
description: Equipped with everything you need for classic muscle building and strength progression. Features a wide range of dumbbells, Olympic & standard barbells, incline, flat, and decline benches, plus sturdy squat stands.
highlights: Complete dumbbell rack (2.5kg to 35kg+)
Standard & Olympic barbells with plate sets
Flat, incline & decline bench press stations
Squat stands & rubberized lifting floor

title: Muscle & Cable Machines
description: Guided selectorized machines that let beginners and experienced lifters isolate every muscle group with proper form and zero joint stress. Ideal for chest, back, shoulders, arms, and legs.
highlights: Lat pulldown & seated cable row station
Heavy leg press & quad/hamstring machines
Pec-fly / rear-delt machine & chest press
Multi-cable crossover station for arm & chest isolation

title: Cardio & Fat Loss Zone
description: Dedicated aerobic machines designed to help you burn calories, improve stamina, and warm up effectively before weight training.
highlights: Motorized incline treadmills for walking & running
Elliptical cross-trainers for smooth cardio
Stationary spin bikes for endurance
Easy-to-use speed and calorie burn tracking

title: Core, Warmup & Stretching Space
description: A dedicated open floor area with mats and accessories for daily abdominal exercises, resistance band warmups, and post-workout cool down stretching.
highlights: Cushioned mats for abs & core workouts
Battle ropes for high-energy conditioning
Kettlebells & resistance loop bands
Stretching and mobility accessories

title: Friendly Unisex Ambience
description: A clean, well-ventilated unisex workout floor where both male and female members can train comfortably with helpful floor guidance and energetic gym music.
highlights: Safe & comfortable environment for men and women
Helpful floor trainers to demonstrate exercises
Well-ventilated hall with good air circulation
High-energy workout playlist to keep you pumped
